name: io.github.exactjsondev/exactjson
title: ExactJSON — Live, deterministic x402 APIs for AI agents
description: Live, deterministic x402 APIs for AI agents: 31 Base USDC market, security, world & science tools.

tools.name: exactjson_health
tools.description: Free: Check ExactJSON API availability, version, network (Base eip155:8453), and paused status before running paid workflows.

tools.name: exactjson_solana_safety
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 USDC): Audit a single Solana SPL token mint before swapping: RugCheck 0-100 risk_score, mint/freeze/mutable authority flags, LP lock %, and DEX liquidity/FDV ratios. Do NOT use for EVM 0x tokens (use exactjson_evm_safety) or broad pool discovery (use exactjson_solana_trending). Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

mint.description: Base58 Solana SPL token mint address (32-44 characters).

tools.name: exactjson_solana_trending
tools.description: Paid ($0.015 USDC): Discover live trending Solana pools pre-screened in parallel with RugCheck risk_score, authority flags, liquidity, and 24h trader flow. Use to find active SPL pools filtered by max_risk_score. Do NOT use for auditing a specific known mint (use exactjson_solana_safety). Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

limit.description: Optional number of trending tokens to return (integer 1-8, default 5).

max_risk_score.description: Optional ceiling (0-100) to return only RugCheck-verified tokens at or below this risk score.

tools.name: exactjson_perps_snapshot
tools.description: Paid ($0.005 USDC): Fast single-coin Hyperliquid perpetual check: mark/oracle basis, annualized funding APR, open interest, L2 depth imbalance, and $10k VWAP slippage. Use for one known ticker. Do NOT use for market-wide scanning (use exactjson_perps_screener) or multi-tier sizing (use exactjson_execution_quote_check). Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

coin.description: Hyperliquid perpetual ticker symbol (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL, kPEPE; optional -PERP suffix stripped).

tools.name: exactjson_perps_screener
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 USDC): Scan all ~180+ Hyperliquid perpetuals in one call for market breadth, median funding APR, extreme funding leaderboards, mark/oracle basis dislocations, and turnover. Do NOT use for cross-exchange funding spreads (use exactjson_perps_funding_arb) or single-coin L2 depth (use exactjson_perps_snapshot). Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

min_oi_usd.description: Optional minimum open interest USD filter (default 1000000).

limit.description: Optional leaderboard size per category (1-25, default 10).

tools.name: exactjson_perps_funding_arb
tools.description: Paid ($0.015 USDC): Compare live hourly and annualized perpetual funding rates across Hyperliquid, dYdX v4, and Kraken Futures to surface cross-venue funding arbitrage spreads and bottleneck leg OI. Do NOT use for single-venue Hyperliquid screening (use exactjson_perps_screener) or order routing. Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

min_oi_usd.description: Optional minimum per-venue open interest USD filter applied to each participating leg (default 100000; ignored when coin is set).

limit.description: Optional number of top cross-venue spreads to return (1-25, default 10).

coin.description: Optional base asset symbol filter (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL).

tools.name: exactjson_predictions_scanner
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 USDC): Scan live Polymarket & Kalshi prediction markets in one call for implied probabilities, bid-ask spreads, keyword topic search, 24h volume/liquidity, and annualized carry to expiry. Do NOT use for cross-venue arbitrage matching (use exactjson_predictions_arb). Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

venue.description: Optional venue filter: all (default), polymarket, or kalshi.

query.description: Optional keyword search across market titles, tickers, and categories (1-64 chars).

min_volume_24h_usd.description: Optional minimum 24h USD volume filter (default 1000; default 0 when query is set).

limit.description: Optional leaderboard size per category (1-25, default 10).

tools.name: exactjson_options_surface
tools.description: Paid ($0.015 USDC): Distill 600+ live Deribit BTC or ETH option contracts into ATM IV term structure, contango/backwardation slope, OTM put-call skew, put/call OI ratios, Max Pain strike, and Call/Put OI walls. Do NOT use for equity options, altcoin spot prices, or perp funding (use exactjson_perps_snapshot). Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

currency.description: Underlying asset symbol: BTC (default) or ETH.

tools.name: exactjson_macro_liquidity
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 USDC): Measure the USD macro liquidity regime from 5 official US Treasury and NY Fed feeds: public debt, TGA cash flows, ON RRP balance, EFFR/SOFR funding spread (bps), and net USD liquidity impulse. Do NOT use for non-US central bank rates or token-level DeFi metrics. Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

lookback_obs.description: Optional number of recent business-day observations for liquidity delta (integer 2-20, default 5).

tools.name: exactjson_evm_safety
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 USDC): Audit an ERC-20 token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, or BSC before swapping: GoPlus + Honeypot.is simulation, buy/sell/transfer taxes, engine disagreement flags, and DEX liquidity. Do NOT use for Solana mints (use exactjson_solana_safety) or multi-size slippage quotes (use exactjson_execution_quote_check). Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

address.description: EVM ERC-20 token contract address (0x followed by 40 hex characters).

chain.description: Optional EVM chain: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, or bsc.

tools.name: exactjson_predictions_arb
tools.description: Paid ($0.02 USDC): Detect overlapping Polymarket vs Kalshi prediction markets (72h expiry window) with cross-venue arbitrage spreads, fee-adjusted net edge (bps), APY, and resolution_risk_warning flags. Always verify venue rules before acting. Do NOT use for general topic browsing (use exactjson_predictions_scanner). Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

min_spread_bps.description: Optional minimum fee-adjusted net edge in basis points (0-5000, default 150).

min_liquidity_usd.description: Optional minimum per-venue liquidity USD filter (default 5000).

query.description: Optional keyword search across matched market titles/categories (1-64 chars).

limit.description: Optional maximum opportunities to return (1-30, default 15).

tools.name: exactjson_execution_quote_check
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 USDC): Simulate pre-trade execution slippage across USD size tiers ($1k/$10k/$50k+) for EVM DEX swaps (KyberSwap) or Hyperliquid perp L2 books: price_impact_bps, max_size_under_100bps_usd, and liquidity_grade. Do NOT use for honeypot/rug checks (pair with exactjson_evm_safety first) or order execution. Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

mode.description: Required mode: 'perps' (Hyperliquid L2 orderbook) or 'evm' (KyberSwap DEX aggregator).

coin.description: Required when mode=perps: Hyperliquid ticker symbol (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL).

chain.description: Optional when mode=evm: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, or bsc.

token_out.description: Required when mode=evm: destination ERC-20 token address (0x...).

token_in.description: Optional when mode=evm: source ERC-20 token address (defaults to native USDC on chain).

token_in_decimals.description: Optional when mode=evm: decimals (0-18) required only for custom non-registry token_in.

sizes_usd.description: Optional comma-separated USD tiers (up to 3 for evm, 4 for perps; e.g. '1000,10000,50000').

tools.name: exactjson_macro_global_rates
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 USDC): Compress BIS 38-country central bank policy rates, ECB DFR/MRR/ESTR, Bank of Canada CORRA, and NY Fed EFFR/SOFR into a global policy-rate, 12-month hike/cut cycle, real-time overnight spread, and G10/EM carry differential matrix. Do NOT use for US Treasury debt/TGA/RRP flows (use exactjson_macro_liquidity) or T+2 banking settlement dates (use exactjson_commerce_settlement_window). Informational market/security data only; not financial advice.

base.description: Optional carry benchmark currency or ISO-2 jurisdiction (default USD; e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, CHF, GBP, CAD, XM, US).

group.description: Optional central bank filter: all (default), g10, em, hiking (12m net hikes), or cutting (12m net cuts).

countries.description: Optional comma-separated ISO-2 or currency codes (e.g., 'US,XM,JP,GB,CA,BR,MX'; Eurozone states map to XM/EUR).
